title: Developer Guide for modulr
text: Welcome developer guide modulr (v0.3.1), R package foundr ecosystem provides Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) module creation, soft-thresholding topology analysis, topological overlap matrix (TOM) calculations, eigentrait extraction multiparent genetic cross data (specifically Collaborative Cross mouse studies). document details package architecture, data models, developer environment setup, function references, organizing WGCNA objects downstream foundr routines, testing procedures, release guidelines.

title: Developer Guide for modulr
text: ID (data.frame tbl_df): Standardized metadata containing columns ID (strain_sex_condition), animal, strain, sex, condition/diet. Generated via wgcna_ID(). dendro (hclust): Hierarchical clustering tree produced fastcluster::hclust() using average linkage TOM dissimilarity matrix. eigen (data.frame): Matrix/data frame module eigentraits (first principal component module trait expressions), leading "" prefix removed. Rownames match sample ID identifiers. trait: Measurement gene symbol. module: Assigned module color factor ordered module size (number traits). kME: Module membership correlation coefficient (r∈[−1,1]r \[-1, 1]) eigentrait.

previous_headings: Data Pipeline & WGCNA Harmonization Methodology > 2. Topological Overlap Matrix (TOM) Dissimilarity & Soft Thresholding
title: modulr Data Pipeline & WGCNA Harmonization Methodology
text: Given matrix X∈ℝN×PX \\mathbb{R}^{N \times P} NN samples PP traits: Pearson Correlation Matrix: Compute pairwise Pearson correlations Sij=cor(xi,xj)S_{ij} = \text{cor}(x_i, x_j). Adjacency Matrix: Apply soft-thresholding power β\beta: Aij=|Sij|β(unsigned networks)A_{ij} = |S_{ij}|^\beta \quad (\text{unsigned networks}) Topological Overlap Matrix (TOM): TOMij=lij+Aijmin⁡(ki,kj)+1−Aij\text{TOM}_{ij} = \frac{l_{ij} + A_{ij}}{\min(k_i, k_j) + 1 - A_{ij}} lij=∑uAiuAujl_{ij} = \sum_u A_{iu} A_{uj} measures shared connectivity, ki=∑uAiuk_i = \sum_u A_{iu} node degree. TOM Dissimilarity Matrix: dissTOMij=1−TOMij\text{dissTOM}_{ij} = 1 - \text{TOM}_{ij}

title: modulr Data Pipeline & WGCNA Harmonization Methodology
text: Initial Clustering: Fast average-linkage hierarchical clustering performed dissTOM\text{dissTOM}. Adaptive Branch Cut: Branches dynamically cut based shape parameters (deepSplit = 2, minClusterSize = 4). Eigentrait Merging: Module eigentraits (first principal component) calculated initial modules. Modules whose eigentraits exhibit correlation distance less thresholdMEDiss (default 0.25, corresponding r≥0.75r \ge 0.75) merged single module using WGCNA::mergeCloseModules(). kME Correlation: Pairwise correlations every trait xjx_j every module eigentrait E(m)E^{(m)} computed via WGCNA::signedKME().

title: modulr Developer Guide Overview & Architecture
text: modulr (v0.3.1) R package within foundr ecosystem providing Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) module creation, soft-thresholding topology analysis, topological overlap matrix (TOM) calculations, eigentrait extraction multiparent genetic cross data (specifically Collaborative Cross mouse studies). Author: Brian S. Yandell (brian.yandell@wisc.edu) License: GPL-3 Minimum R Version: ≥ 3.5.0 Related packages ecosystem: foundrHarmony: Data ingestion, normalization (nqrank()), domain-specific spreadsheet parsers (userHarmony), multi-dataset binding (bind_traits()). modulr: Standardizing WGCNA co-expression trait module creation, soft-thresholding topology estimation, TOM dissimilarity matrices, eigentrait extraction. foundr: Core statistical analysis, linear model estimation, orthogonal variance partitioning (partition()), summary stats (strainstats()), S3 trait classes, ggplot2 visualizations. foundrShiny: Interactive Shiny web application providing modular UI components reactive visual analysis panels.

title: modulr Function Index & WGCNA Trait Module Breakdown
text: harmonized wgcnaModules S3 object comprises four principal components: $ID: Sample metadata table produced wgcna_ID() maintaining alignment across strain, sex, condition, animal. $dendro: hclust hierarchical tree object generated TOM dissimilarity, allowing visual inspection cluster branches via plot_wgcnaModules(). $eigen: Module eigentrait matrix columns correspond module colors (e.g. blue, turquoise, brown) rownames correspond standardized sample IDs. Eigentraits represent 1st principal component module. $modules: Tidy data frame output module_factors() containing mapping individual traits, assigned module color factors (ordered module trait count), kME correlations (r∈[−1,1]r \[-1, 1]).
